title: Continuous background music with persistent mute control

requirements.summary: Add continuous looping background music that persists across question/celebration stage transitions and references the user-provided track source link in comments.
acceptanceCriteria: Background music starts and continues playing across stage transitions (question <-> celebration) without restarting due to component remounts.
Music loops continuously when it reaches the end.
The implementation references the provided link in code comments or documentation as the user-provided source reference, without breaking the app if the link is unreachable.

file_operations.description: Create a React hook that owns a single long-lived HTMLAudioElement instance (looping enabled) so playback does not restart across Valentine stage transitions; include a code comment referencing the user-provided source: https://youtube.com/shorts/Zy02CEOqrR4?si=ULEbg8LDnjIwxoc3, while still loading audio only from a local static asset path.

Integrate the background-music hook at the page level (outside the stage conditional branches) so the audio instance is created once and persists while switching between question and celebration UIs; ensure looping behavior is enabled and stage changes do not reset playback position.

requirements.summary: Serve background music from a static frontend public asset and play it via a stable /assets/... URL (no YouTube streaming/embedding).
acceptanceCriteria: The app does not attempt to embed or stream audio from the YouTube Shorts URL.
The audio file is loaded from a local static path under frontend/public and is requested successfully in the browser network tab (200).
No backend changes are required to deliver the audio bytes.

file_operations.description: Add the background music audio file as a static asset under the public folder so it can be requested directly by the browser (no backend involvement).
Configure the audio element source to load from the local static path /assets/audio/glue-song-sped-up-pitched.mp3 (do not fetch/stream from the YouTube link); set appropriate preload/loop behavior.

requirements.summary: Add an accessible Music On/Off control in the existing header, with state persisted across reloads and instant mute/unmute behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: A clearly discoverable control is present on the page (e.g., in the header area) with English label text such as “Music: On/Off” (or equivalent).
The control is keyboard accessible and has appropriate aria-labels.
Turning music off immediately silences playback; turning it on resumes playback.
The music setting persists for the user across page reloads (e.g., via localStorage).

file_operations.description: Add a header-area toggle control with visible text label (e.g., “Music: On/Off”), keyboard accessibility, and aria-label; keep styling consistent with the current Valentine theme and responsive layout. Use the shadcn-ui Button component for the control; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the header music toggle to the background-music hook state (on/off) and ensure the UI updates immediately; pass props/callbacks to Header so it can display and toggle current music state.
Persist the user’s music enabled/disabled preference in localStorage and restore it on load; ensure toggling off mutes/pauses immediately and toggling on resumes from the current position.

requirements.summary: Make audio start behavior compatible with autoplay policies by deferring playback until a user gesture is available and avoiding console errors.
acceptanceCriteria: On first page load, if autoplay is blocked, the app does not throw errors and provides a clear path to start music via the music toggle control.
After the user’s first interaction (e.g., tapping the music toggle or another primary action), playback can start successfully.
No console errors are emitted during audio initialization/cleanup when switching stages or pressing Start over.

file_operations.description: Handle play() promise rejections gracefully to support autoplay-blocked scenarios (track whether playback requires a user gesture); expose safe methods for toggle/attempt-start without throwing and ensure cleanup (pause/unload) does not emit console errors.

Ensure a user interaction path can trigger playback when needed by invoking the hook’s safe attempt-start logic from the music toggle and (when appropriate) from primary interactions already present in the experience (e.g., button clicks), without adding intrusive prompts; confirm no errors during stage transitions or Start over.

Ensure the music toggle control can initiate playback after a user gesture (click/keyboard) when autoplay was blocked, providing a clear path to start audio without intrusive prompts. Use the shadcn-ui Button component for consistent behavior; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
